takeaways: Copilot only sees what is indexed and permissioned in Microsoft Graph, so approvals, tickets and exceptions living in external systems stay invisible until you connect them.
Custom Graph connectors need mapped identities, a rich schema, source-faithful ACLs based on Entra ID and latency targets that stream critical status changes.
Treat connectors as governed business assets with an owner and lifecycle, and start with the one system whose missing context causes the most rework.
hook: Copilot gives confident but wrong answers when approvals, tickets and exceptions live in systems outside Microsoft 365. This episode shows architects and IT leaders why integrated is not the same as indexed and how custom Graph connectors close those blind spots. You learn a practical model for live, permission-trimmed ingestion that turns Copilot into a process-aware advisor.
